title: Media facts and probe cache
summary: Measured dimensions, duration and stream facts; still placement duration; digest-keyed cache and sandboxed FFprobe binding. Cached facts are derived state, not media authorization.

carrier.notes: Original: lumeri_runtime.media_facts:facts_from_ffprobe,MediaFactsCache,bind_probe, running ffprobe in its sandbox profile. Replacement: a lumeri.engine.program/v1 capability with module "lumeri.media.facts", naming an executable file of its Luc, started with the original's arguments, environment and profile, writing only the session scratch (luc_engine_programs, sandbox.MacOSSandboxExecutor.bind_capability).

replaceability.why: A replacement is code. It is one executable file of a Luc that holds engine.program, which Lumeri's review of its exact bytes grants, and it stands in for ffprobe: the Runtime starts it with the same arguments, environment, working directory and sandbox profile, except that it may write only the session scratch, never the Project. It runs only on a machine with a sandbox (macOS today) (docs/luc/engine-programs.md).
replaceability.decided: today's code: lumeri_runtime/media_facts.py:107-147; Acrab 2026-10-26: replaced by engine programs in the engine's own sandbox

reach.notes: The program reads what the original may read and writes only the session scratch; it runs only what the original may run (the profile's executables), with no network. The Runtime checks what it leaves and keeps the Project, the cache and the events.

operations.name: facts_from_ffprobe
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced. Uses first video/audio streams and maximum positive duration from format/streams. Images have no measured duration; malformed numeric fields may raise built-in exceptions.

operations.name: placement_duration
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced. Images place for 3 seconds; otherwise use positive measured duration or None.

operations.name: MediaFactsCache.get
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced. Missing, unreadable or invalid JSON returns None; valid objects are not revalidated against the facts schema.

operations.name: MediaFactsCache.put
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced. One cache file is replaced atomically; cache contents and Project revision are independent and there is no client_op_id result commit. Repeating the same cache write replaces identical content.

operations.name: bind_probe
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced. Returns bound FFprobe runner whose execution returns parsed stdout JSON and leaves Project revision unchanged. Missing toolchain probe raises ValueError. Runner is a draft opaque object. program is the engine program a reviewed Luc brings for this module, or null; where it covers the run it runs first and the original runs the same request when it breaks.

events.name: luc.module_fell_back
events.notes: Once per Session in a start: when the module's program broke (gate run), or when its Luc was left off for the module after three breaks (gate load). Codes: E_LUC_ENGINE_START, E_LUC_ENGINE_EXIT, E_LUC_ENGINE_RESULT, E_LUC_ENGINE_LIMIT, E_LUC_ENGINE_DEADLINE, E_LUC_ENGINE_CHANGED.

invariants.text: An image has no measured duration; the default placement duration is a separate 3-second value.
When the program breaks after writing in the session scratch, the scratch is restored to its state before the program ran, so the original sees none of what the program wrote.

break: the program cannot be placed, or its bytes are not the ones its Luc loaded with
it does not start in the sandbox, exits with a status other than 0, or leaves a process behind
it outruns the profile's time, memory, process or output limits

its stdout or declared files are not what the original's would be: Its stdout is FFprobe's JSON: an object with a streams list and a format object, from which facts_from_ffprobe reads what a timeline needs.
failure.notes: The original runs the same request at once, and every request of this module for the rest of the start (luc_interactions.note_module_break); three breaks of the same bytes leave the Luc off for the module at later starts until reset (luc_breaker, luc_cli.py modules reset lumeri.media.facts). The creator stopping the request is not a break: the program is stopped and nothing runs in its place.

conformance.notes: tests/test_luc_engine_programs.py holds the load gate, which runs belong to which module, and, with real compiled programs in the media sandbox, an answer in place of FFprobe and FFmpeg, every way of breaking handing the same request to the original, the scratch-only fence, a stop that is not a break, and a real Worker whose measured facts are the program's until it breaks. The engine's own modules share that path; no engine subcommand is replaced by a real program in a test yet.

known_deviations.text: Cache accepts any mapping and writes without fsync or a Project revision transaction. It is regenerable derived data, not an authoritative durable write seam.
